area: the vessel cameras: Swordfish sword reach and pan, Thresher ball framing, Jacks net, Jewel Wasp ride, Shrike docked pull-back
summary: Each of these camera effects now runs for the local player's hull whoever holds its sticks, instead of stopping when the AI flies it (the AI Diagnose panel's You / AI toggle). The gate was '!AutoPilotEnabled'; it is now the hull the camera follows (CameraManager.ActiveRigFollowing). What the pilot's own hand drives is unchanged and still pilot-only: the Thresher's launch view and aim, the Shrike's scope and zoom, shake, haptics and hit-stop. No tuning value changed.
why: Yash: with the AI flying his vessel the camera sat nearer than when he flies it; he wants the player's camera whoever pilots. An AI seat, a remote hull and the menu's lava lamp still move nobody's camera.
